read.en: Teradyne rose 0.4% on Nov 18 to $235.21, trading $228.88–240.46 on light volume (0.43x the 20-day average). It is below the 10-day ($240.3), 5-day ($242.9, rising), 30-day ($297.6), 100-day ($351.7) and 200-day ($349.9), all but the 5-day falling. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 10 ($222.89), and RSI is 35.1.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 11月18日上涨 0.4%，收于 $235.21，盘中区间 $228.88–240.46，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.43 倍）。股价位于 10 日（$240.3）、5 日（$242.9，上行）、30 日（$297.6）、100 日（$351.7）和 200 日均线（$349.9）下方，除 5 日均线外均在下行。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月10日起看多（$222.89），RSI 为 35.1。

read.en: No level changed: the $240.46 high cleared the Nov 16–17 highs ($238.85) intraday but the close fell back, and the $228.88 low dipped under $229.7 before recovering. Resistance is $237.6–240.5, then $240.3–246 (10-day, Nov 13 low, 5-day, Nov 9 close) and $250–254.3. Support is $228.9–231.9, then $222.5–222.9 (SAR, Nov 9 and 17 lows) and $211.6–212.7. A close above $240.5 would target $243–246; below $228.9, $222.5.
